title: Combined assignment on a free coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P$ be a set of coordinates in $ in n$, and let $z$ assign a sign to each coordinate in $P$ while $y$ assigns a sign to each coordinate outside $P$. For every coordinate $i$ outside $P$, the assignment that uses $z$ on $P$ and $y$ elsewhere takes the value $y(i)$ at $i$.
